run_id_provenance: Assigned during repository migration because the original execution did not retain a canonical run identifier or a verified execution timestamp.
historical_execution_metadata_availabili: The retained records do not provide the original resolved configuration, complete input snapshot, canonical run ID, execution timestamps, code commit, model checkpoints, or random seeds.
